pkgmetadata.longdescription: Duplicati is a free, open-source backup client that securely stores encrypted, incremental, compressed and deduplicated backups on cloud storage services and remote file servers (S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, Backblaze B2, WebDAV, SSH/SFTP, FTP and many others). All data is encrypted with AES-256 (or GPG) before it leaves the machine. This is the pre-built, self-contained GUI bundle: it embeds its own .NET runtime and ships the Avalonia tray icon, the local web UI, the command-line client and the headless server. Installs a desktop entry and application icons.
